title: Device-flavor benchmarking and publication playbook for A100/H100/L40S/MI300
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Create a repeatable playbook to benchmark, validate, and publish device-specific performance profiles (A100, H100, L40S, MI300 variants) and define an automated safe-rollback contract for pinned model versions. This ticket captures calibration sampling, golden-run artifact requirements, acceptance gates, publication metadata, and operational runbooks for profile drift detection.
acceptance_criteria: Benchmark harness runs for all four device families with the agreed sample suite and produces reproducible latency and throughput signatures
Publication artifact schema (JSON) defined and validated by QA and Console teams
Automated re-pin trigger thresholds documented and integrated with the signature-monitoring dashboard
Canary rollback playbook written and tested against a synthetic incident in staging
Owners and reviewer list confirmed and handoff scheduled with release ops
steps: Finalize canonical sample-suite: 10 prompts per family covering short/med/long sequences and chat stateful flows
Run warm/cold runs across representative machines for each GPU SKU and capture p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, memory headroom, and kv-cache amplification
Produce 'golden-run' artifacts: raw traces, perf-summary.csv, deterministic seed model output, and checksum manifest
Validate artifacts against stability thresholds (max p95 drift 12% vs baseline, tail noise < 5ms for short seqs)
Generate profile JSON including: device_family, variant_label, expected_latency_map, batch_recommendations, quantization_compatibility, caveats
Publish profile to model-catalog with semantic version and changelog entry; create console release note linking profile
Wire profile to routing policy so that model-serving can prefer the targeted variant; ensure fallback chain documented
Add automated monitor: daily signature diff job that raises alert when drift exceeds thresholds and queues a revalidation job
notes: We intentionally separate 'variant_label' from hardware SKU to allow vendor-side naming differences (e.g., h100-80gb vs h100-120gb).
Small-sample hardware noise for MI300 in our region required extending warm-up runs from 2 to 5 iterations to stabilize KV cache behavior.
Decision: profiles will include a recommended batch-size range rather than single value to allow runtime autoscaling heuristics to operate.
Trade-off: collecting deterministic model outputs increases test runtime but provides stronger regression guarantees for pin decisions.
Follow-up: add an obfuscated workload that approximates production input distribution for higher-fidelity signatures (tracked separately).
implementation_decisions: Store published profiles in model-catalog under /profiles/{model}/{device_family}/{semver}
Expose a 'revalidate' API endpoint that triggers a fresh golden-run on demand
Use checksum manifest to ensure artifact integrity before publication
